campaign: Deterministic RSI storage, execution, and grounded capability control plane
doctrine: OvergoDB remains the sole canonical artifact transaction authority. Modularization separates a small hash-chained metadata journal, immutable content-addressed blobs, compiled Go projections and checkpoints, and bounded operational coordination while preserving artifact.Repository, global ordering, atomic batches, alias compare-and-set, lineage validation, read-only refresh, backup, retention, and deterministic replay. High-volume observations are chunked into blobs and committed through bounded summaries; heartbeats, wake signals, and partial process output remain operational unless they cause a meaningful durable transition. Multica and semantic-router are used only as independently re-expressed inventories of operational problems and observable behavior: no source, schema, file format, runtime, Markdown skill, plugin mechanism, or product layer is copied. Modern and Marin Overgo source integrations remain subordinate to the same common owners and ratchets; repository, commit, license, path, mechanism, or transform provenance is evidence only and can never grant capability or execution authority. docs/plan.json is the sole live execution plan; imported branch plans, roadmaps, design records, staged-surface manifests, and historical Git snapshots are evidence or inventories only and cannot schedule work, satisfy dependencies, or grant completion. RSI uses four shared components rather than domain platforms: one typed and falsifiable cross-domain candidate spine, one evidence-gated promotion and rollback lifecycle, one evidence-driven budget and stop driver, and one transport-neutral UTCP effect, approval, and receipt contract. Model, composition, mechanism, dataset, routing, steering, and code logic enter only as compiled Go candidate-source, realization, or evaluator plugins. AgentTaskContract or DelegatedAgentInvocation provides the task ceiling, active AutomationPolicyLifecycle provides a standing unattended grant within that ceiling, and operatoraction HumanDecision is the argument-bound per-action grant; the shared StageReceipt binds whichever exact authority was consumed. Agent-initiated and cross-process or peer calls may resolve the invocation contract through UTCP transports; deterministic in-process orchestration calls existing Go owners directly and shares only the contract and receipt shape, never the tool transport. Derived decisions are distribution-free where justified and otherwise bind their distribution assumptions, explicit missing-data coverage, and architecture tests that refuse bypasses. One shared sequential-control owner calibrates frozen Phase I incumbent limits and applies them in Phase II with replay-measured in-control run length and shift detection delay on the exact ordered, autocorrelated stream; common-cause or insufficient evidence cannot request lifecycle, budget, or autonomy mutation. The first capability proof is one local same-base composite advanced only to a supervised non-serving verified state while the production incumbent and unattended grant remain unchanged; advanced plugins, optimization, peer transport, rollout, live safety, concurrency, and closure are built from its persisted trace rather than ahead of it. Interaction efficiency is an external behavior: equal or better task capability with fewer semantic commits, journal documents, lineage edges, projection scans, decoded blobs, bytes, wakeups, context repetitions, model turns, capability invocations, approval rounds, tool calls, retries, and waits. Every optimization starts from a measured representative interaction trace, preserves exact admitted inputs and evidence, consolidates common policy or mechanics, and deletes the displaced path in the same commit. Grounded capability learning adapts only the highest-value PentAGI and RAGFlow concepts through existing Go owners: capability episodes are rebuildable projections over exact run-record authority; structural hybrid retrieval remains dataset-owned and emits evidence only when consumed; production probes, evidence-dominant routing, and exact trajectory supervision remain subordinate to typed placement, invocation, lifecycle, and receipt authority; reusable episode knowledge enters only as an admitted immutable dataset transform with independent held-out benefit. No second event log, mutable agent-memory service, provider router, external runtime, vector or graph database, prompt-owned workflow, Markdown skill, copied source, or free threshold is introduced.

items.title: Add harder composition rungs through the same spines only after the same-base proof

steps.title: Add deterministic component retrieval and one bounded frozen-donor alignment-adapter ladder
steps.rationale: Only after the reproducible held-out same-base win, extend the existing projection with fixed-schema unit-normalized component descriptors, exact deterministic retrieval, content-addressed Procrustes or OT seam evidence, and one bounded donor-to-seam-to-adapter ladder. Freeze donors, train only the interface adapter through bridgetrain, assemble through synthesis, bias-audit the pretraining residual against post-training parity, and require target, composed, dropped-source, and shuffled-source arms under multidimensional fitness. These are Candidate source, realization, and evaluator plugins of the shared spines, not a normalized-catalog service, composition runtime, admission owner, publisher, or lifecycle. HDC and broad cross-architecture search remain refused until exact retrieval is a measured blocker with an explicit reopen trigger.

steps.title: Admit bounded composition search and budget widening only from measured learning and calibration
steps.rationale: Extend the shared DriverDecision only after the alignment ladder exists and generic counterfactual replay can measure it. Derive weakest-domain, regression, and frontier-gap requests from immutable evaluations; aggregate strategy-tagged attempts into held-out fitness delta per compute, candidate hit rate, adapter cost, refusal and saturation history, and predicted-versus-actual calibration without a hidden threshold. A composition budget may widen only after a positive held-out learning curve, calibrated predictions, complete ablations, and beneficial special-cause evidence from the shared frozen sequential-control plan; adverse special cause narrows or stops, while common cause and insufficient evidence preserve the current budget. This step adds no composition loop, free search knob, policy, activation path, or lifecycle authority; any later production request still traverses the shared rollout and promotion adapter.

items.title: Adapt data, routing, scale, health, and architecture mechanisms after the first proven loop

steps.title: Extend candidate compilation and materialization with evidence-gated data, MoE, DenseToMoE, architecture, and expert-placement plugins
steps.rationale: After the simple composite proves the shared loop, migrate Marin mechanism, dataset-transform, routing, DenseToMoE, model-architecture, and expert-placement eligibility through compiled adapters on the persisted-Candidate admission entry, then delete their parallel admission records and private eligibility codecs in the same slice. They remain registered Go Candidate source and realization plugins rather than new control planes. Deterministic data stages bind memory and intermediate-byte budgets, durable stage checkpoints, exact resume, and classified failure. MoE targets and quantile estimates remain evidence-bound; controller code alone changes routing; router semantics stay separate from placement and transport. DenseToMoE is a later architecture-change rung requiring exact screen and expert inventory evidence and cannot self-promote. Expert parallelism refuses without a measured single-device placement, memory, or throughput blocker and one authorized multi-device target. Model-authored predictions retain measured outcome and calibration; frontier mechanisms remain independent candidates with component ablations rather than a bundled label. Plugins reuse and extend the admission ratchet, common compiler, publication, recipe, driver, and lifecycle owners and introduce no distributed platform or scheduler.

steps.title: Extend isolated evaluation with bounded scaling, training-health, router-coverage, and expert-parallel evidence
steps.rationale: Extend the already-proven isolated process and evaluator owners, using the post-proof bounded training-evidence mechanic for raw router and health samples. Bind exact scaling rungs, configurations, seeds, datasets, evaluators, active and measured costs, health phases, controller checkpoints, router scope coverage, assignments, bytes, collectives, topology, sender and receiver overflow, drops, synchronization, and memory. Training-health adapters supply typed ordered statistics to the shared sequential-control owner and consume its evidence; they cannot own windows, persistence, boundaries, or action. Fits refuse extrapolation or regime mixing; effective speedup compares identical observed quality and compatible units; MoE arms include paired baseline, constrained, dropless, shift, and lag cases. Expert-parallel evidence selects at most one bounded transport against the local reference and proves checkpoint and retry recovery. Plugin summaries cannot duplicate raw telemetry or create comparison, promotion, retry, rollback, or lifecycle authority; incomplete coverage or partial publication refuses.

items.title: Use the shared invocation contract for agent-initiated and cross-boundary capability reuse

steps.title: Complete staged delegation and receipted peer capability invocation without routing internal Go through UTCP
steps.rationale: Complete and retire the staged CapabilityProxyManual and RegisterCapabilityProxy, NewDelegatedCoordinator, CompileDelegatedAgentInvocation, and NewMutationCheckpointRuntime surfaces through existing command, server, runtime, approval, execution, and receipt owners. A lane or peer exposes a compiled Go capability as an exact effect-classed UTCP manual; consumers invoke it across the boundary instead of importing or duplicating runtime code. Bind PeerCapabilityPublication, enrollment, heartbeat, compatibility, and placement to the active CatalogSnapshot, Manual, and CapabilityIdentity; recheck publication and lease immediately before bounded no-redirect http-json-stream dispatch; then publish the shared StageReceipt with canonical arguments, effect, targets, inspection, task or delegation ceiling, HumanDecision or active policy, causal context, and head. Remote recipe validation requires that exact manual and placement. Inspection propensity may later be steered only while every resolved capability is inspection-class; mutation stays alpha zero and behind approval. Deterministic in-process orchestration continues to call Go owners directly and never enters UTCP resolution or transport. This adds no second registry, admission, placement, execution, approval, receipt, lifecycle, or policy owner.

items.title: Split cmd/gate into an internal/gate hierarchy with one transaction path

steps.title: Extract admission, preparation, verification, commit, finalization, and recovery into internal/gate packages; cmd/gate keeps flags and composition
steps.rationale: One top-level transaction path remains; the split must not create independently callable competing gates.

items.title: Narrow the server assembly root by capability boundary

steps.title: Split serving protocols, operator and workflow API, agent API, hub and download API, workbench, and assembly; each workspace receives an explicit dependency struct
steps.rationale: No workspace reaches the entire handler; authorization, shutdown ownership, and route testing audit against explicit dependencies.

items.title: Establish enforceable size and coupling budgets

steps.title: Ratchet maximum production file size, direct internal dependencies per package, command-package responsibility, and staged path count per ordinary gate commit
steps.rationale: Warnings first, enforcement after existing exceptions are recorded as reviewed entries.

items.title: Tighten the model abstraction to its stated boundary

steps.title: Move genericizable family checks into profile policies, type chat templates where token boundaries determine them, add a family-named-branch census, and adjust the README claim
steps.rationale: A new model expressible through existing primitives introduces no family-named branch in shared execution code; the census enumerates every remaining branch outside catalogs, errors, fixtures, and presentation.

items.title: Raise risk-weighted verification depth over serving and operator surfaces

steps.title: Raise host inference coverage toward sixty percent over cache shifting, prompt reuse, speculative decoding, sampling, cancellation, and lifecycle; require host-reference tests per compiled operator policy and CUDA parity per activated-recipe operator
steps.rationale: Separate coverage summaries for hermetic logic, real browser, real CUDA, and installed models keep an aggregate number from hiding weak execution paths.

steps.title: Replace the fixed model path in the GUI launcher, correct the kernels README, decide the compute_89 floor, add root license and policy documents, remove the unused innerHTML facility, and prefer in-memory API keys with opt-in persistence
steps.rationale: Each decision lands as either the fix or a recorded closure naming why the current state is intentional.
